horizons.horizon_convention: whole weeks from the issue date to the END of the target week (0 = nowcast); same as app/data_io.horizon_weeks and the hashed R0/R1 rounds: nowcast, +1, +2, +3 wk after issue. The primary display label is the target week-ending date.
